curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how far ahead to look, the checks at intersections, in the mirrors and over the shoulder, and why tracking traffic matters.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per scanning habit; a contrast card separating the block-ahead rule from following distance.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about where and how far to look.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the counting method, the time a count takes, more distance at speed and in poor conditions, and why tailgating causes crashes.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; a contrast card for the four-second count versus the three-to-six-second cushion.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions that test the count and when to add distance.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show how to keep space around the car, give bicycles room, help the driver behind, and handle a tailgater.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each space rule; contrast cards for seconds versus feet and the tailgater response.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about a tailgater and a bicycle in your lane.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define blind spots, then how to clear your own, stay out of others', see past obstructions and enter traffic safely.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for your blind spots versus others' and for trusting a turn signal.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about shoulder checks and pulling out from a driveway.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach when to signal, how far ahead, the exception for turns just past an intersection, canceling, right-of-way, and hand signals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each signaling rule; contrast cards for the distance and the past-the-intersection exception.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about signal timing and what a signal does and does not give you.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through passing on the left, returning to the lane, passing slower road users, being passed, and the two cases for passing on the right.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each passing rule; contrast cards for the return cue, being passed and right-side passing.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about when you may pass and how to return.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec06-m01..sec06-m06; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist
